blocks.text: Optimize your Outlook workflow on Mac

Managing travel itineraries requires precision. You likely spend hours in Outlook daily. Start by organizing your inbox with folders for each client or trip status. You can create a folder in Outlook on Mac by right-clicking your mailbox and selecting New Folder. This keeps your GDS confirmations separate from general inquiries.

Standard shortcuts save time. Use ⌘ + N to start a new email. Use ⌘ + Return to send. If you need custom shortcuts for specific menu items, go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Click the plus button, select Microsoft Outlook, and type the exact name of the menu command. Assign a key combination that makes sense to you.

Travel agents face constant communication overload. You can [create an email signature in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/create-an-email-signature-in-outlook) to ensure your contact details and licensing info appear on every message. If you find yourself typing the same responses to common questions, use the dictation feature. Hold the fn key to dictate clean text. This prevents repetitive strain and keeps your hands moving.

Rules help you sort incoming booking confirmations. You can [create a rule in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/create-a-rule-in-outlook) to move emails from specific suppliers to dedicated folders. This ensures you never miss a critical update from your GDS providers like Amadeus or Sabre. If you are unsure how to set up a complex rule, ask Lazur to guide you through the process step by step.

Travel agents must track flight times, hotel check-ins, and tours. You can [create a calendar event in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/create-a-calendar-event-in-outlook) for every itinerary item. If you share your calendar with colleagues, remember to [share your calendar in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/share-your-calendar-in-outlook) to keep everyone updated on your availability.

items: Ignoring the New Outlook toggle: You should use the latest version for better sync performance.
Forgetting to sync: Always check your connection status if emails seem delayed.
Manual filing: Use search filters instead of keeping thousands of emails in your inbox.
Overlooking security: Always block suspicious senders immediately.
Ignoring updates: Keep your macOS on version 14 or later to ensure Outlook remains stable.

blocks.text: Sometimes you need to [delay delivery of an email in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/delay-delivery-of-an-email-in-outlook) to ensure it reaches a client in their local time zone. This is a simple way to appear more professional. If you have an email that requires action later, [set a reminder for an email in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/set-a-reminder-for-an-email-in-outlook). This keeps your task list focused on what is happening today.

When you have thousands of emails, finding one booking ID is hard. Use [search with filters in Outlook on Mac](/how-to/search-with-filters-in-outlook) to narrow down results by sender, date, or attachment type. This is much faster than scrolling. If you struggle with the search interface, ask Lazur to point at the filter options for you.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Outlook?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you, points at things, or explains how to perform a task so you can do it yourself.

faq.question: Is Outlook for Mac free?
faq.answer: Outlook for Mac is part of the Microsoft 365 subscription. Check the official Microsoft website for current pricing and plan details.

faq.question: How do I switch to the new Outlook interface?
faq.answer: You can toggle between the New and Legacy versions using the Outlook menu in the top menu bar of your Mac.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on older versions of macOS?
faq.answer: Lazur requires a modern version of macOS. Check our system requirements page for compatibility details.
